_source: Litz, Applied Ballistics for Long-Range Shooting, 3rd ed. (2015), Appendix A
_provenance: Extracted 2026-08-01 from Documentation/"Applied Ballistics for LRS.pdf", PDF pages 377-424 (printed 368-415). Numeric columns via pdftotext -bbox positional extraction; pages 407/416/417/423/424 were image-only in the text layer and were transcribed by rendering the page. PRIMARY SOURCE - live-fire measured data.
_caveats: Bullet NAMES carry OCR noise; numeric columns are validated by the identity i7 == SD/G7 BC.
weight_gr is computed as SD*7000*d^2, not read from the name; it agrees with the printed name weight within 2 gr on 305/313 checkable rows.
PDF page 393 (.264 caliber) is image-only and was NOT recovered - roughly 12 rows short there.
Library is the 2015 edition: bullets released later (Hornady ELD-M, Berger 215 Hybrid) are absent.
